title: Conditional activation Mirror steering
hypothesis: A shared rank-4 activation basis plus per-behavior Givens codes reduces CAST behavior-vector storage while preserving conditional efficacy and false-trigger rate on held-out condition-behavior pairs.
physical_object: Shared synthetic 64x4 steering basis plus rank-4 seed, and CAST condition prototypes/keys
mirror_coordinate: Two FP16 Givens angles per behavior; optional FP16 private residual
logical_multiplicity: 16 behavior activations selected by 32 continuous conditions
controls: CAST with explicit FP32 behavior vectors and cosine condition gate
Shared basis with FP16 behavior coefficient table
Shared basis plus seed and per-behavior FP16 Givens angles
Mirror plus FP16 private residual per behavior

task.type: synthetic continuous condition x behavior activation steering
task.primary_metric: false-trigger rate on negative held-out pairs

development.allowed: No hyperparameter tuning; validate deterministic encoding and condition gate.

paid_objects: condition prototypes and behavior condition keys
explicit behavior vectors or compact behavior codes

success_gate: For every rho=0 fresh world: false-trigger <=.05, miss <=.05, efficacy >=.99, off-target drift <=.01, and Mirror bytes <=80% of cheapest generic coefficient control.
failure_gate: Conditional quality fails or Mirror misses the 20% byte advantage over generic FP16 coefficient storage.
boundaries: Same CAST condition gate is used by every representation method; routing and vector reconstruction are reported separately.
No pretrained language behavior or capacity claim.
